name: Fractions Basics
description: Understanding numerators, denominators, and visual representations of fractions as parts of a whole.

name: Equivalent Fractions & Simplifying
description: Generating equivalent fractions by multiplying or dividing numerator and denominator by the same non-zero factor.

name: Finding Common Denominators (LCM)
description: Finding least common multiples to convert fractions to have identical denominators.

name: Adding & Subtracting Fractions
description: Adding and subtracting fractions with like and unlike denominators using common denominators.

name: Multiplying Fractions
description: Multiplying numerators and denominators, canceling common factors, and scaling fractional quantities.

name: Dividing Fractions & Reciprocals
description: Dividing fractions by multiplying by the reciprocal (keep-change-flip).

name: Negative Numbers & Integers
description: Understanding positive and negative signed integers, number lines, and integer arithmetic rules.

name: Order of Operations (PEMDAS)
description: Applying standard operator precedence: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication & Division, Addition & Subtraction.

name: Variables & Algebraic Expressions
description: Evaluating algebraic expressions with variable substitution and understanding algebraic terms.

name: Combining Like Terms
description: Simplifying algebraic expressions by grouping terms with identical variable components and adding coefficients.

name: One-Step Equations (Add/Subtract)
description: Solving one-step linear equations of the form x + a = b using additive inverse operations.

name: One-Step Equations (Multiply/Divide)
description: Solving one-step linear equations of the form ax = b or x/a = b using multiplicative inverse operations.

name: Distributive Property
description: Multiplying a single term over terms inside parentheses: a(b + c) = ab + ac.

name: Two-Step Linear Equations
description: Solving linear equations in the form ax + b = c by undoing addition/subtraction then multiplication/division.

name: Multi-Step Equations (Variables Both Sides)
description: Solving complex linear equations involving the distributive property, combining like terms, and variables on both sides.

name: Linear Inequalities
description: Solving linear inequalities and remembering to flip the inequality sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative number.
